lineage.data_type: Entirely synthetic fictional short Russian support feedback, with limited English code-switching.
lineage.personal_data: No real people, customers, contacts or personal data used.
lineage.authored_from: Parent-supplied input schema, task policy and independently designed test scenarios only.
lineage.implementation_access: No implementation, prompts, previous datasets or results read during holdout construction.
lineage.label_source: AI-authored provisional judgments; no human has annotated or approved these labels.
lineage.contamination_boundary: Before implementation freeze, only paths, counts, hashes and schema are shared with implementation/evaluation coordinator; no case texts or topic answers.
lineage.chronology_note: Dataset freeze time alone does not prove implementation freeze or blind execution. Coordinator must record code commit/hash and run timestamps separately.
lineage.generating_script: build_frozen_dataset.py; no model execution or external data retrieval

evaluation_caveats: Small designed synthetic holdout, not an estimate of real production prevalence or quality.
Provisional expectations require independent human review before any human-quality or ground-truth claim.
A first clean run may be used as a holdout result; subsequent tuning on inspected cases converts it into development data.
Identity ambiguity is kept explicit. No invented identities may satisfy recurrence thresholds.
All records lie inside the evaluation window; separate boundary-date tests are needed to claim time-window edge coverage.
